page.layout: One printed page, single column. At the top right, the page number 283. Centred title block: "Liber octauus Actionum" in large roman, then "MARTYRVM." in spaced italic capitals. Below it a subtitle line, then five lines of names, each set in spaced capitals with a rule under the fourth. Then the body text in one column, opening with a decorated initial, followed by a signature mark at the bottom right. Small partly cropped fragments of marginal text run down the left edge of the page.

main_text.head: Liber octauus Actionum MARTYRVM.
Historia de actis quinque Martyrum, qui exusti sunt Cameriaci, vbi suprema est Curia Sabaudiae, nempe
main_text.p: [illegible, ~2 letters]X[?] eo tempore quo Dominus pro singulari boni-tate sua Euangelium Geneuae publicari voluit, quum suos circiter viginti annos in ea tutatus ef-set, tandem velut ex septis suis & arena permul-tos emisit athletas fortissimos, qui veritate suam sincere hominibus patefacerent. Ac non ita pridem quinque eximios testes doctrinae suae produxit, qui hanc coram senatu Cameriacensi constanter assererent: quorum tres nempe Ioannes Vernutius Pictauus, Antonius Laborierius Cahorti Quercia-norum natus, ac legum peritus, quique iudicij regij officio illic defun-ctus erat: & Ioannes Trigaletus Nemausensis, iuris etiam peritus, ecclesiae Geneuensis consensu delecti ad promulgandum Christi Euangelium, munus hoc libenter & summis animis susceperunt, vt qui iam antea se Dei mandato & vocationi consecrauerant.

Etsi autem non i-ta stupidi nec hebetes erant, quin facile perspicerent quae suis capitibus imminebant pericula, & ignes quasi iam accensos praeuiderent: Studium tamen illud pium quo seruire Dei gloriae cupiebant pro sua vocatione sanctissima, illos sic perpulit, vt omnem hostium veritatis truculentiam plusquam barbaram contemnerent: atque etiam licet quidam vir pius illos praemonuisset quum viam ingressi sunt, periculum esse ne comprehenderentur in itinere, nullo tamen metu nec terrore percelli aut abstrahi potuerunt quin pergerent quo erant vocati. Duo item alij, Guyraudus scilicet Tauranus Cahorti Quercianorum natus, ac mercator: & Bertrandus Batallius natione Vasco & schoo-

page.notes: Left margin: partly cropped marginal fragments run the full height of the left edge, unreadable beyond a few letters each; shown above only as one placeholder, the rest not legible. The initial letter is a decorated woodcut; its form reads as X but the word is probably In[?], so the first letter is doubtful. Long s is transcribed as s throughout. The bottom-right mark "Oo" is treated as a gathering signature. The line "schoo-" ends a word on a printed hyphen, continuation not on this page.
